sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 但如果你是一个普通人，并没有对这些不同的事件着迷，那么当你周三早上抬头看电视时，你看到的

sentences.en: The investigation found substantial evidence that when the president ordered Don McGahn to fire the
sentences.zh: 调查发现了大量证据表明，当总统命令唐·麦甘解雇

sentences.en: special counsel and then lie about it, Donald Trump, one, committed an obstructive act.

sentences.en: version of this hearing, would be to draw from Robert Mueller the concession that if Donald Trump were not president, he would be charged with a crime.
sentences.zh: 版本，是从罗伯特·穆勒口中得到一个让步：如果唐纳德·特朗普不是总统，他就会被控犯罪。

sentences.zh: 他直接切入了关于报告的主要问题之一，即：如果不是因为那条

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Mike, let's turn to the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 那么迈克，让我们转向共和党人。

sentences.en: You told us that their goal was to maintain the status quo.
sentences.zh: 你告诉我们，他们的目标是维持现状。

sentences.en: Remind us exactly what that is.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下，这具体是指什么？

sentences.en: To get Mueller to reinforce the notion that there was no criminal conspiracy between the Trump campaign and Russia.
sentences.zh: 让穆勒强化这样一种观念：特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯之间不存在刑事共谋。

sentences.en: So they sort of initially took a similar approach to Nadler and asked Mueller yes or no questions.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最初采取了与纳德勒类似的方法，问了穆勒一些是非题。

sentences.en: Is that any true?
sentences.zh: 那是真的吗？

sentences.en: Your investigation did not establish that members of the Trump campaign conspired or coordinated with Russian government in the election interference activity.
sentences.zh: 你们的调查并未证实特朗普竞选团队成员在选举干预活动中与俄罗斯政府存在共谋或协调行为。

sentences.en: Volume one, page two.
sentences.zh: 第一卷，第2页。

sentences.en: Volume one, page one seventy three.
sentences.zh: 第一卷，第173页。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That affirmed the most important point to them.
sentences.zh: 这证实了对他们来说最重要的一点。

sentences.en: Isn't it true?
sentences.zh: 难道不是吗？

sentences.en: The evidence did not establish that the president or those close to him were involved in the charged Russian computer hacking or active measure
sentences.zh: 证据并未证实总统或其亲信参与了被指控的俄罗斯计算机黑客攻击或积极措施

sentences.en: conspiracies or that the president otherwise had unlawful relationships with any Russian official.
sentences.zh: 共谋，也未证实总统与任何俄罗斯官员之间存在非法关系。

sentences.en: Volume two, page seventy six.
sentences.zh: 第二卷，第76页。

sentences.en: Correct?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: I leave the answer to the report.
sentences.zh: 答案我留给报告本身。

sentences.en: So it was a yes.
sentences.zh: 所以答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: But they quickly pivoted to a different issue, which they picked out for a fair amount of time.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快转向了另一个议题，并花了不少时间在这上面做文章。

sentences.en: And it turned out to be something a bit surprising.
sentences.zh: 结果发现这有点令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Why do we have all of this investigation of President Trump that the other side is talking about when you knew that you weren't going to prosecute him?
sentences.zh: 既然你早就知道不会起诉特朗普总统，为什么还要进行对方所说的所有这些调查？

sentences.en: It was why, Mueller, if you knew you weren't going to indict the president, did you continue with your investigation and produce this massive document with really embarrassing
sentences.zh: 穆勒，如果你知道自己不会起诉总统，为什么还要继续调查，并炮制出这份包含特朗普令人尴尬的

sentences.en: things about Trump and voiced it on the public?
sentences.zh: 内容的大部头文件，还把它公之于众？

sentences.en: You made no decision.
sentences.zh: 你没有做出决定。

sentences.en: You told us this morning and in your report that you made no determination.
sentences.zh: 你今天早上和在报告中都告诉我们，你没有做出定论。

sentences.en: So respectfully, director, you didn't follow the special counsel regulations.
sentences.zh: 所以恕我直言，局长，你没有遵守特别检察官条例。

sentences.en: It clearly says, write a confidential report about decisions reached.
sentences.zh: 条例明确规定，要就已达成的决定撰写保密报告。

sentences.en: Nowhere in here does it say, write a report about decisions that weren't reached.
sentences.zh: 这里面根本没说要就未达成的决定撰写报告。

sentences.en: You wrote 180 pages,
sentences.zh: 你写了180页，

sentences.en: 180 pages about decisions that weren't reached, about potential crimes that weren't charged or decided.
sentences.zh: 180页关于未达成决定的内容，关于那些未被起诉或未被定性的潜在犯罪。

sentences.en: That kind of reminds me of something that you and I have discussed before, which is how former FBI director James Comey handled the Hillary Clinton email server episode.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起你我之前讨论过的一件事，那就是前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米是如何处理希拉里·克林顿邮件服务器事件的。

sentences.en: He decides not to indict, comes out, gives a press conference, in many people's minds, maligns her.
sentences.zh: 他决定不起诉，然后出来召开新闻发布会，在许多人看来，这诋毁了她。

sentences.en: And afterwards, the question is, aren't you not supposed to do that if you decline to prosecute?
sentences.zh: 事后人们的问题是，如果你决定不起诉，不是不应该那样做吗？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Republicans are making a decent point about how criminal investigations of our politicians are ended.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在如何结束针对我们政客的刑事调查这一点上，说得很有道理。

sentences.en: How should we disclose facts about them?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何披露关于他们的事实？

sentences.en: And at the same time, being a bit disingenuous because when Comey felt he needed to come out and lay out some of the evidence that they
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们也有点虚伪，因为当科米觉得有必要出来陈述他们在调查中收集到的一些证据时，

sentences.en: had collected in their investigation, the Republicans took that and ran with it to undermine her as a presidential candidate.
sentences.zh: 共和党人却利用这一点大做文章，以削弱她作为总统候选人的地位。

sentences.en: So now they're outraged that we're looking at the fruits of a criminal investigation in which the central player, the president, has not been charged.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他们对我们审视一项刑事调查的成果感到愤怒，而在这项调查中，核心人物——总统——并未受到指控。

sentences.en: And they're complaining about it in a similar fashion to the way that Democrats complain about how Comey handled the Clinton thing.
sentences.zh: 他们抱怨的方式，和民主党人抱怨科米处理克林顿事件的方式如出一辙。

sentences.en: The drafting and the publication of some of the information in this report without an indictment, without prosecution, frankly, flies in the face of American justice.
sentences.zh: 在没有起诉、没有检控的情况下，撰写并公布这份报告中的部分信息，坦率地说，是违背美国司法精神的。

sentences.en: And I find those facts, this entire process, un-American.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些事实，整个过程，都是反美国的。

sentences.en: It showed that the Republicans were not going to stop at anything to attack Mueller, that they were
sentences.zh: 这表明共和党人为了攻击穆勒不择手段，他们

sentences.en: going to throw every single issue they could come up with, regardless of whether it was an intellectually honest one or not.
sentences.zh: 打算抛出他们能想到的每一个议题，不管这是否在智识上诚实。

sentences.en: And that's not maintaining the status quo.
sentences.zh: 那可不是在维持现状。

sentences.en: That is, undermining the special counsel and raising as many questions as possible about his investigation.
sentences.zh: 那是在破坏特别检察官的工作，并尽可能多地对他的调查提出质疑。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It cut at his motivations in a way that other attacks on the investigation did not.
sentences.zh: 这以其他针对调查的攻击所没有的方式，动摇了他的动机。

sentences.en: It went directly to Mueller's character and decisions he had made during the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这直接指向了穆勒的人格以及他在调查期间所做的决定。

sentences.en: And what was Mueller's response to this?
sentences.zh: 那么穆勒对此有何回应？

sentences.en: It was similar to many responses he had during this, which was sort of like...
sentences.zh: 这和他在此期间的许多回应类似，就像是……

sentences.en: Can you give me an example other than Donald Trump, where the Justice Department determined
sentences.zh: 除了唐纳德·特朗普，你能给我举个例子吗？司法部认定

sentences.en: that an investigated person was not exonerated because their innocence was not conclusively determined?
sentences.zh: 某位被调查者没有被免除嫌疑，因为他们的清白没有被最终确定？

sentences.en: I cannot, but this is a unique situation.
sentences.zh: 我不能，但这是一种特殊情况。

sentences.en: Okay, well, you can't...
sentences.zh: 好吧，你不能……

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I can't agree with that characterization.
sentences.zh: 我无法认同这种定性。

sentences.en: Well...
All right, like, you made your point.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你的观点表达清楚了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And it seemed like part of a larger strategy he was employing to sort of run out the clock, let him say whatever they want, acknowledge it, and move on.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是他所采用的更大战略的一部分，即拖延时间，让他们说想说的，表示知晓，然后继续推进。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay, so what else did the Republicans focus on?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么共和党人还关注了什么？

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, they went back to their greatest hits on the investigation.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，他们又回到了调查中最引人注目的老调重弹上。

sentences.en: Most prosecutors want to make sure there was no appearance of impropriety, but in your case, you hired a bunch of people that did not like the president.
sentences.zh: 大多数检察官都想确保没有不当行为的嫌疑，但在你的案子里，你雇了一群不喜欢总统的人。

sentences.en: And raised questions about whether the investigators were biased.
sentences.zh: 并对调查人员是否存在偏见提出了质疑。

sentences.en: Let me ask you, when did you first learn of Peter Strzok's animus toward Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 请问，你是什么时候第一次得知彼得·斯特佐克对唐纳德·特朗普的敌意的？

sentences.en: In the summer of 2017.
You didn't know before he was hired for your team?
sentences.zh: 在他被聘入你的团队之前你不知道吗？

sentences.en: Uh, you know what?
sentences.zh: 呃，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Peter Strzok hated Trump.
sentences.zh: 彼得·斯特佐克讨厌特朗普。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You didn't know that before he was made part of your team.
sentences.zh: 在他成为你团队的一员之前，你并不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Is that what you're saying?
sentences.zh: 你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: I did not know that.
sentences.zh: 我确实不知道。

sentences.en: All right, uh, when did you first learn of...
sentences.zh: 好吧，呃，你是什么时候第一次得知……

sentences.en: When I did find out, I acted swiftly to have him reassigned elsewhere in the...
sentences.zh: 当我发现时，我迅速采取行动，将他重新分配到……

sentences.en: They also picked at continuously...
sentences.zh: 他们还不断挑剔……

sentences.en: The media first began spreading this conspiracy theory in the spring of 2016, when Fusion GPS,
sentences.zh: 媒体在2016年春天首次开始散布这种阴谋论，当时由民主党全国委员会和希拉里·克林顿竞选团队资助的Fusion GPS公司，

sentences.en: funded by the DNC and the Hillary Clinton campaign, started developing the Steele dossier.
sentences.zh: 开始编制斯蒂尔档案。

sentences.en: The document of unverified allegations about ties between Trump and Russia.
sentences.zh: 一份关于特朗普与俄罗斯之间联系的未经证实的指控文件。

sentences.en: Well, I, what I can tell you is that the events that you are characterizing here now is part of another matter that is being handled by the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我，我能告诉你的是，你现在所描述的这些事件是司法部正在处理的另一件事的一部分。

sentences.en: Which Mueller had said, I'm not going to talk about.
sentences.zh: 穆勒已经说过，我不会谈论这件事。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, I, again, I'm not going to discuss the issues with regard to Mr. Steele.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我，再次重申，我不会讨论关于斯蒂尔先生的问题。

sentences.en: It was this persistent effort throughout the entire time, even though at the top of the hearing, he said he would not discuss it.
sentences.zh: 尽管在听证会开始时他就说过不会讨论这个问题，但这种坚持不懈的努力贯穿了整个过程。

sentences.en: Did your office consider whether the Russian government used Steele's sources to provide Steele with disinformation?
sentences.zh: 你的办公室是否考虑过俄罗斯政府是否利用斯蒂尔的消息来源向斯蒂尔提供虚假信息？

sentences.en: Again, I can't speak to that.
sentences.zh: 同样，我无法谈论这一点。

sentences.en: I understand I'm asking these questions just for the record, so thanks for your patience.
sentences.zh: 我明白，我问这些问题只是为了记录在案，感谢你的耐心。

sentences.en: Mike, you started off by saying that success for the Republicans was maintaining the status quo, which may just be confirming the basic outlines of the Mueller report,
sentences.zh: 迈克，你一开始说共和党人的成功在于维持现状，这可能只是确认了穆勒报告的基本轮廓，

sentences.en: especially the fact that there's no criminality.
sentences.zh: 特别是没有犯罪事实这一点。

sentences.en: But I wonder if this Republican strategy of focusing on all of these issues that raise questions about the investigation is a different kind of success for the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 但我怀疑共和党人专注于所有这些对调查提出质疑的议题，是否对他们来说是另一种成功。

sentences.en: Because they just kept bringing them up, and Robert Mueller didn't really offer much pushback.
sentences.zh: 因为他们一直不断地提起这些问题，而罗伯特·穆勒并没有真正进行太多的反击。

sentences.en: For the most part, he kind of just seemed to disconnect.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，他似乎只是置身事外。

sentences.en: I think so, in some ways, because they knew they would have, or they certainly had, a person they were questioning who wasn't going to engage and fight and push back that hard.
sentences.zh: 我认为在某种程度上是这样，因为他们知道他们面对的是一个不会参与争斗、不会激烈反击的质询对象。

sentences.en: So it gave them the opportunity to sort of create their own soundbites of them giving it to Mueller while he was up there.
sentences.zh: 所以这让他们有机会创造出属于自己的声音片段，展示他们在穆勒出席时对他进行质询的场景。

sentences.en: And to that end, I think that it was successful, although they never really got Mueller to bite.
sentences.zh: 就此而言，我认为他们成功了，尽管他们从未真正让穆勒上钩。

sentences.en: Mike, what about Mueller and what you said would represent success for him?
sentences.zh: 迈克，关于穆勒，你认为什么才代表他的成功？

sentences.en: Did he achieve what he wanted in these hearings?
sentences.zh: 他在这些听证会上实现了他想要的目标吗？

sentences.en: Towards the end of the day...
sentences.zh: 在一天快结束时……

sentences.en: Director Mueller, you've been asked many times this afternoon about collusion, obstruction of justice, and impeachment in the Steele dossier,
sentences.zh: 穆勒局长，今天下午你被多次问及勾结、妨碍司法公正以及斯蒂尔档案中的弹劾问题，

sentences.en: and I don't think your answers are going to change if I ask you about those questions.
sentences.zh: 我不认为如果我再问你这些问题，你的答案会有所改变。

sentences.en: So I'm going to...
sentences.zh: 所以我打算……

sentences.en: Congressman Will Hurd of Texas.
sentences.zh: 来自德克萨斯州的国会议员威尔·赫德。

sentences.en: Ask Mueller.
sentences.zh: 问穆勒。

sentences.en: As a former CIA officer, I want to focus on something I think both sides of the political aisle can agree on.
sentences.zh: 作为一名前中情局官员，我想关注一个我认为政治两派都能达成共识的问题。

sentences.en: That is, how do we prevent Russian intelligence and other adversaries from doing this again?
sentences.zh: 那就是，我们如何防止俄罗斯情报机构和其他对手再次这样做？

sentences.en: And you see sort of Mueller perk up and begin to really engage on this issue in a way that he hadn't on others.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到穆勒振作起来，开始真正投入到这个问题上，这是他在其他问题上所没有的。

sentences.en: In your investigation, did you think that this was a single attempt by the Russians to get involved in our election,
sentences.zh: 在你的调查中，你认为这是俄罗斯人试图干预我们选举的唯一一次尝试，

sentences.en: or did you find evidence to suggest they'll try to do this again?
sentences.zh: 还是你发现了证据表明他们会再次尝试这样做？

sentences.en: Oh, it wasn't a single attempt.
sentences.zh: 哦，这绝非唯一一次尝试。

sentences.en: They're doing it as we sit here.
sentences.zh: 就在我们坐在这里的时候，他们正在这样做。

sentences.en: And he sort of gets a chance to ring the alarm bells about interference issues.
sentences.zh: 他有机会就干预问题敲响警钟。

sentences.en: And they expect to do it during the next campaign.
sentences.zh: 而且他们预计在下次竞选中还会这样做。

sentences.en: And the Democrats lean into this, and they're able to make something of it.
sentences.zh: 民主党人顺势而为，并能够利用这一点做文章。

sentences.en: If we could put up slide six.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能展示第六张幻灯片。

sentences.en: This just came out.
sentences.zh: 这刚出来。

sentences.en: WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 维基解密。

sentences.en: I love WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 我爱维基解密。

sentences.en: Donald Trump, October 10th, 2016.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普，2016年10月10日。

sentences.en: This WikiLeaks stuff is unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这些维基解密的东西真是令人难以置信。

sentences.en: It's like a treasure trove.
sentences.zh: 就像一个宝库。

sentences.en: Donald Trump, October 31st, 2016.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普，2016年10月31日。

sentences.en: Congressman Quigley from Chicago brings up the fact that Donald Trump praised WikiLeaks.
sentences.zh: 来自芝加哥的国会议员奎格利提到了唐纳德·特朗普赞扬维基解密的事实。

sentences.en: Do any of those quotes disturb you, Mr. Director?
sentences.zh: 局长先生，这些引言中是否有让你感到不安的？

sentences.en: I'm not certain, I would say.
sentences.zh: 我不确定，我会这么说。

sentences.en: How do you react to that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何反应？

sentences.en: Well, it's probably problematic is an understatement in terms of what it displays, in terms of giving some, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，说这可能是有问题的都算是轻描淡写了，就它所展示的内容而言，就它给予某种，我不知道，

sentences.en: hope or some boost to what is and should be illegal activity.
sentences.zh: 希望或某种推动力给本应是非法活动的行为而言。

sentences.en: Congressman Welsh asks Mueller.
sentences.zh: 国会议员威尔什问穆勒。

sentences.en: Have we established a new normal from this past campaign that is going to apply to future campaigns, so that if any one of us running for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们是否已经从上次竞选中确立了一种将适用于未来竞选的新常态，以便我们中任何竞选美国

sentences.en: House, any candidate for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 众议院的候选人，任何竞选美国

sentences.en: Senate, any candidate for the presidency of the United States, aware that a hostile foreign power is trying to influence an election,
sentences.zh: 参议院的候选人，任何竞选美国总统的候选人，在意识到有敌对外国势力试图影响选举时，

sentences.en: has no duty to report that to the FBI or other authorities?
sentences.zh: 都没有义务向联邦调查局或其他当局报告？

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请继续。

sentences.en: I hope this is not the new normal, but I fear it is.
sentences.zh: 我希望这不是新常态，但我担心它就是。

sentences.en: And then Chairman Schiff.
sentences.zh: 然后是希夫主席。

sentences.en: From your testimony today, I gather that you believe that knowingly accepting foreign assistance during a presidential campaign is an unethical thing to do.
sentences.zh: 从你今天的证词中，我推断你认为在总统竞选期间明知故犯地接受外国援助是不道德的行为。

sentences.en: And a crime.
sentences.zh: 而且是犯罪。

sentences.en: And a crime.
sentences.zh: 而且是犯罪。

sentences.en: Circumstances, yes.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，是的。

sentences.en: And to the degree that it undermines our democracy and our institutions, we can agree that it's also unpatriotic.
sentences.zh: 而且在它破坏我们的民主和制度的程度上，我们可以同意它也是不爱国的。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And wrong.
sentences.zh: 而且是错的。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We should hold our elected officials to a standard higher than mere avoidance of criminality, shouldn't we?
sentences.zh: 我们难道不应该要求民选官员达到比仅仅避免犯罪更高的标准吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对应该。

sentences.en: So this is a different Mueller than we've seen throughout the hearing, and he's definitely stepping outside the four corners of the report.
sentences.zh: 所以这与我们在整个听证会期间看到的穆勒不同，他确实跳出了报告的条条框框。

sentences.en: It feels like in those last few exchanges, he's kind of offering clear, tough judgments about the conduct of the president, not in terms of necessarily crimes committed,
sentences.zh: 感觉在最后几次交流中，他是在对总统的行为做出清晰、严厉的评判，这不一定是指犯了什么罪，

sentences.en: but just in terms of basic right and wrong.
sentences.zh: 而仅仅是从基本的是非曲直角度来看。

sentences.en: The report is about an investigation that looks at whether laws are broken.
sentences.zh: 这份报告是一项调查，旨在查看是否有人触犯了法律。

sentences.en: It wasn't looking at that.
sentences.zh: 它并没有关注这一点。

sentences.en: It wasn't looking at questions of patriotism.
sentences.zh: 它也没有关注爱国主义的问题。

sentences.en: Mike,
sentences.zh: 迈克，

sentences.en: you told us before these hearings that Democrats were determined to get Mueller to bring this report to life and thereby eventually shift public opinion on the president's culpability.
sentences.zh: 你在听证会前告诉我们，民主党人决心让穆勒把这份报告“演活”，从而最终改变公众对总统罪责的看法。

sentences.en: To counteract the narrative that the president and that the attorney general, Bill Barr have outlined that Trump did nothing wrong, that this is a witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 以反击总统和司法部长比尔·巴尔所宣扬的叙事，即特朗普没有做错任何事，这只是一场政治迫害。

sentences.en: And this is a waste of time.
sentences.zh: 而且是在浪费时间。

sentences.en: In the end, given everything you've just laid out, did the Democrats fulfill that mission?
sentences.zh: 最后，鉴于你刚才所说的一切，民主党人完成那个使命了吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We'll have to see what the political fallout is and whether it really pushes House members to embrace impeachment.
sentences.zh: 我们还得看看政治后果如何，以及这是否真的会推动众议院议员支持弹劾。

sentences.en: But we didn't walk out of that hearing today with any major new disclosure about the president's behavior.
sentences.zh: 但我们今天走出听证会时，并没有听到关于总统行为的任何重大新披露。

sentences.en: But I do want to remind you of something you told us the day before the hearing, which is that a realistic form of Democratic success,
sentences.zh: 但我确实想提醒你，你在听证会前一天告诉过我们，一种现实的民主党式成功，

sentences.en: if they were not going to get Robert Mueller to say that the president committed a crime or would have been charged if he weren't president,
sentences.zh: 如果他们无法让罗伯特·穆勒说出总统犯了罪，或者说如果他不是总统就会被起诉的话，

sentences.en: would be to just get him to affirm that the president's major talking points are false.
sentences.zh: 那么成功就是让他确认总统的主要论点是错误的。

sentences.en: Was there no obstruction?
sentences.zh: 没有妨碍司法吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Was there no collusion?
sentences.zh: 没有勾结吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Did you exonerate the president?
sentences.zh: 你为总统洗清罪名了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: And the Democrats did get many different forms of that.
sentences.zh: 民主党人确实得到了许多不同形式的这类回答。

sentences.en: And so does that not meet your own threshold for success?
sentences.zh: 那么这难道不符合你自己的成功标准吗？

sentences.en: Well, I understand.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我明白。

sentences.en: Now, now I feel like I'm being questioned.
sentences.zh: 现在，现在我觉得我好像在被审问。

sentences.en: But seriously.
sentences.zh: 但说真的。

sentences.en: In sort of looking back on that, I don't think in the Trump era we've seen major shifts in people's views of him when he's been shown to lie and mislead the public.
sentences.zh: 回顾这一切，我认为在特朗普时代，当他被证明撒谎和误导公众时，我们并没有看到人们对他的看法发生重大转变。

sentences.en: So I get that Mueller has more credibility than most, and it does show that the president had been misleading.
sentences.zh: 所以我明白穆勒比大多数人更有公信力，这确实表明总统一直在误导公众。

sentences.en: But I'm not sure it's that powerful to actually change enough minds to drive this in a different direction.
sentences.zh: 但我不敢肯定这是否有足够的力量去改变足够多的人的想法，从而将事态引向不同的方向。

sentences.en: So is there a version of this where the Democratic strategy, having not achieved the great moment that they needed to actually change public opinion, have had this backfire?
sentences.zh: 那么，有没有一种可能，民主党的策略在没有实现他们真正需要改变公众舆论的伟大时刻后，反而适得其反了？

sentences.en: It may backfire in the sense that they went to these great lengths, they put on this big show, and they didn't walk away with anything major.
sentences.zh: 这可能会适得其反，因为他们费了这么大劲，演了这么大一场戏，结果却一无所获。

sentences.en: And so the question becomes, why did you do it?
sentences.zh: 所以问题就变成了，你们为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Because this was your idea.
sentences.zh: 因为这是你的主意。

sentences.en: Well, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Not just why did you do it, but why are you continuing to investigate it?
sentences.zh: 不仅是为什么要这么做，而是你们为什么要继续调查它？

sentences.en: So if Mueller came up here, you didn't get any new revelations, the Republicans can stand there and say, well, Democrats,
sentences.zh: 所以如果穆勒来到这里，你们没有得到任何新的启示，共和党人就可以站在那里说，好吧，民主党人，

sentences.en: why are you continuing to investigate the president on this?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么要继续就此事调查总统？

sentences.en: Mueller has done his thing.
sentences.zh: 穆勒已经完成了他的工作。

sentences.en: His report is out.
sentences.zh: 他的报告已经发布了。

sentences.en: You could move ahead with impeachment if you want to, but politically you don't.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，你可以推进弹劾，但在政治上你们并不想这样做。

sentences.en: So what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 那么你们到底在做什么？

sentences.en: Right, either impeach or don't impeach.
sentences.zh: 对，要么弹劾，要么不弹劾。

sentences.en: And then let's stop talking about this.
sentences.zh: 然后让我们别再谈论这个了。

sentences.en: Let's not do like sort of a silent impeachment where we're just trying to dredge up anything we can on the president and we really don't have the political will to go ahead and actually do it.
sentences.zh: 我们不要搞那种“无声弹劾”，即我们只是试图挖掘关于总统的任何负面信息，但实际上并没有政治意愿去真正执行它。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Director Mueller, thank you again for being here today.
sentences.zh: 穆勒局长，再次感谢你今天来到这里。

sentences.en: This hearing is adjourned.
sentences.zh: 听证会休会。

sentences.en: The Democrats lost so big today, their party is in shambles right now.
sentences.zh: 民主党人今天输得太惨了，他们的党派现在一团糟。

sentences.en: After the hearings had ended, President Trump addressed reporters from the White House lawn,
sentences.zh: 听证会结束后，特朗普总统在白宫草坪上对记者发表讲话，

sentences.en: saying that Mueller's testimony had been a disaster for Democrats and a vindication for him.
sentences.zh: 称穆勒的证词对民主党人来说是一场灾难，对他来说则是一种平反。

sentences.en: What he showed more than anything else is that this whole thing has been three years of embarrassment and waste of time for our country.
sentences.zh: 他所展示的最重要的一点是，整件事对我们国家来说是三年的尴尬和浪费时间。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the governor of Puerto Rico said he would resign after weeks of massive protests triggered by the release of text messages in which he mocked his own citizens.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，波多黎各总督表示他将辞职，此前因泄露嘲讽本国公民的短信而引发了持续数周的大规模抗议。

sentences.en: The governor, Ricardo Rossello,
sentences.zh: 总督里卡多·罗塞略，

sentences.en: had resisted stepping down but was undermined by hundreds of thousands of protesters who paralyzed the capital city this week as they demanded his ouster.
sentences.zh: 曾拒绝下台，但被本周瘫痪了首府、要求他下台的数十万抗议者所削弱。

sentences.en: And after a lengthy investigation,
sentences.zh: 经过长时间的调查，

sentences.en: the Federal Trade Commission has ordered Facebook to pay a $5 billion fine and submit to significant federal oversight for violating its users' privacy.
sentences.zh: 联邦贸易委员会已命令Facebook支付50亿美元罚款，并因侵犯用户隐私而接受严格的联邦监管。

sentences.en: The settlement signals a new chapter in the government's attempts to regulate powerful technology companies.
sentences.zh: 这项和解协议标志着政府试图监管强大的科技公司进入了新篇章。

sentences.en: But the commission's five members appeared split about whether the settlement went far enough.
sentences.zh: 但委员会的五名成员似乎对该和解协议是否足够严厉存在分歧。

sentences.en: The commission's two Democratic members voted against the deal, saying it would not sufficiently change how Facebook operates.
sentences.zh: 委员会的两名民主党成员投票反对该协议，称其不足以充分改变Facebook的运营方式。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: Here in for the last one.
sentences.zh: 这是最后一个了。

sentences.en: This is a very special decision.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常特别的决定。
